items.title: US too focused on Middle East and not pushing Russia hard enough, Zelensky tells BBC

reading: This is a study version, not a copy of the BBC article. Use it as a longer training text before you open the original link. The news item is a political development. Your first job is to find the actor, the action, and the result.
